path.description: Path to the directory containing the Kustomization file.

labelSelector.description: Label selector for the patch target. Together with kind, this identifies the patch entry to update.

kind.description: Kind for the patch target. Together with labelSelector, this identifies the patch entry to update.

pathToImage.description: JSON pointer path to a full image value in the patch.

pathToRepository.description: JSON pointer path to a repository value in the patch.

pathToTag.description: JSON pointer path to a tag value in the patch.

image.description: Image is a container image to set or update in the Kustomization patch.

digest.description: Digest of the image to set. Mutually exclusive with 'tag' and 'useDigest=true'.

image.description: Image name of the repository from which to pick the version. This is the image name Kargo is subscribed to, and produces Freight for.

name.description: Name of the image as referenced by the patch target.

newName.description: NewName for the image. This can be used to rename the container image name in the manifests.

tag.description: Tag of the image to set. Mutually exclusive with 'digest' and 'useDigest=true'.

useDigest.description: UseDigest specifies whether to use the digest of the image instead of the tag discovered from Freight.
